name: ad-os-baseline
description: Windows member server baseline metrics (CPU, memory, disks, services, event log, hardware identity). R147 — adds BIOS info (manufacturer/name/version/release_date), CPU brand, total physical memory bytes, per-drive physical disk array (DriveType=3 only — local fixed disks, skips CD/network/RAM/virtual), and C: drive used percentage. Schema extended from 8 to 13 columns; v2 metricstore ingest is auto-discovery so centre/ingestRunV2 picks up new fields from metricSchema without ingest-code edits.
